metadata.technology_specification: Automatic capsule filling machine (dosator or tamping pin type)
metadata.technology_reasoning: Automatic capsule filling machines, particularly dosator or tamping pin types, represent the industry standard for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical capsule filling due to their high throughput, precision dosing, and widespread adoption in commercial manufacturing environments as of 2024.

components.reasoning: This subsystem is critical for feeding empty capsules and orienting them correctly before filling, typically a separate module with dedicated supply chains.

components.component: Dosator or Dosing Mechanism (Dosator Unit or Tamping Pins)
components.reasoning: Core functional module that accurately measures and dispenses powder or granules into capsules, universally present and procured separately for maintenance and flexibility.
Houses the dosing units and interfaces directly with capsules during filling; essential subassembly often sourced as a complete unit.
Separates and shuts the capsule body and cap after filling; a distinct mechanical assembly critical to automated operation.
Electronic control system that manages machine operation, dosing, speed, and diagnostics, typically a separate module with its own supply chain.
Provides mechanical support and stability; usually manufactured or procured as a distinct assembly outfitting the other components.
Common in many designs for maintaining clean operation and product integrity, though some smaller or manual machines may integrate this differently.
Includes motors and transmission components that power capsule handling and dosing functions; procured as distinct units.
